name: Goro Tanaka
want: win the prefectural judo tournament, and open a café full of cats one day
secret: He collects plush animals and has a hundred and twelve of them in his dorm room.
voice: Deep and soft, apologises a lot, blushes at compliments.
description: The biggest student in the school; first-years flee from him until they meet him. Lives in the dorm.
appearance: Huge shoulders, a crew cut, a judo bag with a little cat charm.
